# Update issue — `redmine_update_issue`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.ts from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run gen:tools`. -->

_write_

Edit an issue: change status, reassign, reprioritize, adjust dates/done_ratio, and add a comment (notes) in the same call. Returns the re-fetched, updated issue for confirmation.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `issue_id` | integer | **yes** | The numeric id of the issue to update (required). |
| `subject` | string | no | New one-line summary. |
| `tracker_id` | integer | no | New tracker id. NOTE: Redmine silently ignores an unknown id (keeps the current tracker) instead of returning a 422 — verify the tracker on the re-fetched issue. |
| `status_id` | integer | no | New status id (see allowed_statuses). NOTE: Redmine silently ignores an unknown id (keeps the current status) instead of returning a 422 — verify the status on the re-fetched issue. |
| `priority_id` | integer | no | New priority id. |
| `description` | string | no | New description. |
| `assigned_to_id` | integer | no | Reassign to this user id. |
| `parent_issue_id` | integer | no | New parent issue id. |
| `start_date` | string | no | New start date, ISO "YYYY-MM-DD". |
| `due_date` | string | no | New due date, ISO "YYYY-MM-DD". |
| `done_ratio` | integer | no | Percent done, 0–100 in steps of 10. |
| `estimated_hours` | number | no | Estimated effort in hours. |
| `category_id` | integer | no | New issue category id. |
| `fixed_version_id` | integer | no | New target version id. NOTE: Redmine silently ignores an unknown id (or any id when the project has no versions), keeping the current value, instead of returning a 422 — verify the version on the re-fetched issue. |
| `is_private` | boolean | no | Toggle issue privacy. NOTE: applying this depends on your Redmine role permission ("Set issues public/private"). Without it, Redmine silently ignores the flag (privacy unchanged) instead of returning an error — verify is_private on the re-fetched issue. |
| `custom_fields` | object[] | no | Custom-field values as { id, value } entries. |
| `watcher_user_ids` | integer[] | no | Replacement set of watcher user ids. |
| `uploads` | object[] | no | Attachment upload tokens to link. |
| `notes` | string | no | Comment/journal note to record with this change. |
| `private_notes` | boolean | no | Mark the note as private. |

## Example

```json
{
  "name": "redmine_update_issue",
  "arguments": {
    "issue_id": 42,
    "subject": "text"
  }
}
```
